notes_for_editor: Thin record. No build date, height or design found in any readable source. Route 296 location comes from a one-paragraph blog post and is approximate. The Tennessee Landforms table lists the tower at 1697 ft and status 'standing'; the 2014 list is the only dated status record. The blog post's address gives a December 20, 2015 date, but the post describes no status, so it is not used as one. A Facebook group thread turned up in search (snippet says '40-foot fire tower built in 19..') but the page could not be read, so it is not used. Access and climbing rules are unknown; the story tells visitors to check first.
